name: Kohinata Miku
source:
Miku Kohinata () is a character appearing in Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Mei in the Senki Zesshō Symphogear XD Unlimited collaboration event Warrior Princess March. She is a Symphogear wearer sent allied with Hibiki Tachibana and Chris Yukine to track down a missing artifact in the Higurashi world.

[From 07th Expansion Wikia]
